ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

3. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 17

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

11. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

15. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
